sections.text_helper: Section 27.10.1 "SDRAM controller main features" in chapter 27 (Flexible memory controller (FMC)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1266.
sections.section_content:
The main features of the SDRAM controller are the following:
• Two SDRAM devices with control registers
• 8-bit, 16-bit, 32-bit data bus width with narrow width support using DQM byte masking
• 11- to 13-bit Address Row, 8- to 11-bit Address Column, 2 to 4 internal banks
Maximum supported device configurations: 4x16Mx32bits (256Mbytes),
4x16Mx16bits (128Mbytes), 4x16Mx8bits (64Mbytes)
• 64-bit AXI interface with word, half-word or byte access
• SDRAM clock ratio programmable to 1, 2 or 3 (fmc_ker_ck, fmc_ker_ck/2 or
fmc_ker_ck/3)
• Automatic row and bank boundary crossing management
• Multibank back-to-back access
• Programmable timing parameters
• Automatic refresh operation with programmable refresh rate
• Self-refresh mode
• Power-down mode
• SDRAM power-up initialization by software
• CAS latency of 1,2,3
